title: A place for every task
summary: Select a numbered area to learn what it does and open the relevant guide. This diagram summarizes the workspace; your panel arrangement may differ.

hotspots.title: Camera view
hotspots.description: Inspect your map in 3D. Editor, Fly, and Walk have different controls; start by learning how to switch between them.

hotspots.title: Grid views
hotspots.description: Draw and position geometry in Top, Front, or Side views. A grid footprint and the brush depth together define the solid shape.

hotspots.title: Inspector
hotspots.description: Review the active selection and edit its transforms, surfaces, entity properties, and other tool-specific settings.

hotspots.title: Asset browser
hotspots.description: Load your material and model libraries, then find assets to use in the map. Related browser tabs cover prefabs and other object types.

hotspots.title: Editing tools
hotspots.description: Choose brush, face, vertex, clipping, terrain, or painter tools. Keep the active tool and camera mode in mind when using shortcuts.

hotspots.title: Build menu
hotspots.description: Compile the saved map, inspect the build output, and open a compiled preview. The editable source and compiled result serve different purposes.
